from io import BytesIO
import zipfile

import pytest

from ansible.errors import AnsibleError
from ansible.executor import module_common as mc


BASE = ('ansible_collections', 'ns', 'coll', 'plugins', 'module_utils')


def test_package_relative_imports_and_missing_initializers(mocker):
    files = {
        'plugins/module_utils/pkg/__init__.py': b'from .sub import X\\nfrom ..cousin.sub import Y\\n',
        'plugins/module_utils/pkg/sub.py': b'X = 1\\n',
        'plugins/module_utils/cousin/sub.py': b'Y = 2\\n',
    }
    mocker.patch.object(mc, '_get_collection_metadata', return_value={})
    mocker.patch.object(mc.pkgutil, 'get_data', side_effect=lambda pkg, path: files.get(path))
    output = BytesIO()
    with zipfile.ZipFile(output, 'w') as archive:
        mc.recursive_finder('test', 'ansible_collections.ns.coll.plugins.modules.test',
                            b'from ansible_collections.ns.coll.plugins.module_utils import pkg\\n',
                            set(), {}, archive)
        names = set(archive.namelist())
        assert 'ansible_collections/ns/coll/plugins/module_utils/pkg/__init__.py' in names
        assert 'ansible_collections/ns/coll/plugins/module_utils/pkg/sub.py' in names
        assert 'ansible_collections/ns/coll/plugins/module_utils/cousin/sub.py' in names
        assert archive.read('ansible_collections/ns/coll/plugins/module_utils/cousin/__init__.py') == b''
        assert 'ansible/__init__.py' in names
        assert 'ansible/module_utils/__init__.py' in names


def test_redirect_shim_expands_fqcn_and_includes_target(mocker):
    routing = {'plugin_routing': {'module_utils': {'old': {'redirect': 'other.coll.new'}}}}
    mocker.patch.object(mc, '_get_collection_metadata', side_effect=lambda name: routing if name == 'ns.coll' else {})
    mocker.patch.object(mc.pkgutil, 'get_data', side_effect=lambda pkg, path: b'X = 1\\n' if
                 pkg == 'ansible_collections.other.coll' and path == 'plugins/module_utils/new.py' else None)
    output = BytesIO()
    with zipfile.ZipFile(output, 'w') as archive:
        mc.recursive_finder('test', 'ansible_collections.ns.coll.plugins.modules.test',
                            b'import ansible_collections.ns.coll.plugins.module_utils.old\\n',
                            set(), {}, archive)
        shim = archive.read('ansible_collections/ns/coll/plugins/module_utils/old.py')
        assert b'import ansible_collections.other.coll.plugins.module_utils.new as mod' in shim
        assert archive.read('ansible_collections/other/coll/plugins/module_utils/new.py') == b'X = 1\\n'


def test_missing_import_reports_candidates(mocker):
    mocker.patch.object(mc, '_get_collection_metadata', return_value={})
    mocker.patch.object(mc.pkgutil, 'get_data', return_value=None)
    with zipfile.ZipFile(BytesIO(), 'w') as archive:
        with pytest.raises(AnsibleError) as error:
            mc.recursive_finder('test', 'test.module',
                                b'from ansible_collections.ns.coll.plugins.module_utils.pkg import missing\\n',
                                set(), {}, archive)
    assert 'Could not find imported module support code for test.module. Looked for (' in str(error.value)
    assert 'ansible_collections.ns.coll.plugins.module_utils.pkg.missing' in str(error.value)
    assert 'ansible_collections.ns.coll.plugins.module_utils.pkg)' in str(error.value)


def test_tombstone_and_deprecation(mocker):
    warning = mocker.patch.object(mc.display, 'deprecated')
    mocker.patch.object(mc, '_get_collection_metadata', return_value={'plugin_routing': {'module_utils': {
        'old': {'deprecation': {'warning_text': 'use new', 'removal_version': '3.0', 'removal_date': '2027-01-01'},
                'tombstone': {'warning_text': 'removed', 'removal_version': '2.0'}}}}})
    with pytest.raises(AnsibleError, match='removed'):
        mc.CollectionModuleUtilLocator(BASE + ('old',))
    warning.assert_called_once_with('use new', version='3.0', date='2027-01-01', collection_name='ns.coll')
PY
